Wed, 28 Oct, 2:30pm - 3:30pm AEDT

Description

Join us with for a low flow tricks workshop with professional instructor Harley. Low Flow is a floorwork based workshop, focusing on connecting basework tricks into smooth, controlled sequences. 

All skill levels welcomed! Floorwork experience helpful, but absolute beginner friendly too :) 

  • THIS IS A FREE EVENT FOR MEMBERS ONLY! If you are not a member, you can still come, but tickets will be $5 :)

    You'll learn:

  • How to link shapes, transitions, floor pathways, and grounded tricks together with fluidity and intention.

  • Perfect for building flow, musicality, movement confidence, and making your tricks look effortless. No routine, just tricks & combos!

Details:

  • Where: Common Room, inside Holme Building

  • Date: 28/10/26

  • Time: 2:30pm-3:30pm

  • RSVP necessary 

Bring/Wear:

  • Knee pads necessary (PAS Execs will have spares if needed)

  • Pole heels recommend!


See you there xoxo
PAS Exec
